answer_1.quote: Simultaneous machine translation (SiMT) starts to translate with only a partial observation of the source sentence ... We propose two approaches for creating monotonic pseudo‑targets for source sentences in traditional parallel data. This new data is then used to train SiMT models through knowledge distillation (KD).
answer_1.outputs: pseudo‑target translations and SiMT model outputs

answer_2.quote: We use tokenized case‑insensitive BLEU for translation quality and Average Lagging (AL, token level) to measure latency. Hallucination Rate (HR%) measures the percentage of words in the target output that are hallucinated.
